examples.english: The team managed to accomplish the entire renovation in under a month.
examples.persian: تیم موفق شد کل بازسازی را در کمتر از یک ماه به انجام برساند.

examples.english: She wants to accomplish something meaningful before she turns thirty.
examples.persian: او می‌خواهد پیش از سی‌سالگی کار معناداری را به انجام برساند.

examples.english: Few explorers have accomplished what he achieved alone in the Arctic.
examples.persian: تعداد کمی از کاوشگران به تنهایی موفق شده‌اند آنچه او در قطب شمال به انجام رساند را تکرار کنند.

miniContext: The expedition's leader had one modest goal: to accomplish the crossing before the last supply ship left for winter. Storms delayed them for weeks, and at times it seemed impossible to accomplish anything at all. When they finally reached the coast, exhausted but alive, they realized they had accomplished far more than they had set out to do.

examples.english: The committee was forced to acknowledge the error in its original report.
examples.persian: کمیته مجبور شد اشتباه موجود در گزارش اصلی‌اش را بپذیرد.

examples.english: He refuses to acknowledge that his theory has been disproven.
examples.persian: او حاضر نیست بپذیرد که نظریه‌اش رد شده است.

examples.english: The government has finally acknowledged the scale of the famine.
examples.persian: دولت سرانجام گستردگی قحطی را تایید کرد.

miniContext: For years, the company refused to acknowledge any link between its factory and the contaminated river nearby. Lawyers advised executives that to acknowledge even partial responsibility would open the door to lawsuits. It took an independent investigation, not conscience, to force the company to finally acknowledge what residents had been saying all along.

examples.english: Desert plants adapt to extreme heat by storing water in thick leaves.
examples.persian: گیاهان بیابانی با ذخیره‌ی آب در برگ‌های ضخیم خود، با گرمای شدید سازگار می‌شوند.

examples.english: Refugees often have to adapt quickly to an unfamiliar language and climate.
examples.persian: پناهجویان اغلب باید به سرعت با زبان و آب‌وهوایی ناآشنا سازگار شوند.

examples.english: The novel was adapted into a film decades after it was first published.
examples.persian: رمان دهه‌ها پس از انتشار اولش به فیلم تبدیل (اقتباس) شد.

miniContext: Species that cannot adapt to a sudden change in climate tend to vanish within a few generations, while those that adapt, even slightly, often thrive in the gap left behind. Darwin's finches remain the textbook example: isolated on different islands, each population had to adapt to a different available food source. The ones that failed to adapt simply are not there to be studied today.

examples.english: Economists anticipate a slow recovery over the next two years.
examples.persian: اقتصاددانان پیش‌بینی می‌کنند بهبود اقتصادی طی دو سال آینده کند خواهد بود.

examples.english: Good chess players anticipate their opponent's move several turns in advance.
examples.persian: بازیکنان خوب شطرنج حرکت بعدی حریف را چند نوبت زودتر پیش‌بینی می‌کنند.

examples.english: No one had anticipated how quickly the virus would spread across borders.
examples.persian: هیچ‌کس پیش‌بینی نکرده بود که ویروس با این سرعت از مرزها عبور خواهد کرد.

miniContext: Emergency planners are paid to anticipate disasters that most people would rather not imagine, from earthquakes to dam failures. A city that fails to anticipate the obvious risks of its own geography often pays for that oversight many times over in a single afternoon. The best plans anticipate not just what might happen, but how people will panic when it does.

examples.english: Tourists rarely appreciate how harsh the winters here can be.
examples.persian: گردشگران به‌ندرت درک می‌کنند که زمستان‌ها در اینجا چقدر می‌تواند سخت باشد.

examples.english: I would really appreciate your advice before I sign the contract.
examples.persian: واقعاً قدردانی می‌کنم اگر پیش از امضای قرارداد نظرتان را بدانم.

examples.english: She didn't fully appreciate the painting's value until the auction began.
examples.persian: او تا پیش از شروع حراجی به‌طور کامل ارزش نقاشی را درک نکرده بود.

miniContext: Visitors to the old vineyard often fail to appreciate how many generations of careful grafting went into a single bottle of wine. Once the winemaker explains the process, most guests begin to appreciate the slow craft behind what they had taken for granted. It is a lesson in patience: you cannot truly appreciate something built over a century by tasting it for five minutes.

examples.english: The spokesperson was asked to clarify the president's earlier remarks.
examples.persian: از سخنگو خواسته شد اظهارات پیشین رئیس‌جمهور را روشن و شفاف کند.

examples.english: Could you clarify what you mean by a 'temporary' agreement?
examples.persian: می‌توانید روشن کنید منظورتان از توافق «موقت» چیست؟

examples.english: The judge's ruling clarified a point of law that had confused lower courts for years.
examples.persian: رأی قاضی نکته‌ای حقوقی را روشن کرد که سال‌ها دادگاه‌های پایین‌تر را گیج کرده بود.

miniContext: After the press conference descended into confusion, reporters demanded that the minister clarify exactly what the new policy would mean for pensioners. She agreed to clarify the details in a written statement the following morning. Even then, critics argued that the statement raised more questions than it managed to clarify.

examples.english: The two rival laboratories agreed to collaborate on a single vaccine trial.
examples.persian: دو آزمایشگاه رقیب موافقت کردند برای یک کارآزمایی واکسن با یکدیگر همکاری کنند.

examples.english: Artists from six countries collaborated on the mural overlooking the harbor.
examples.persian: هنرمندانی از شش کشور برای دیوارنگاره‌ی رو به بندر با یکدیگر همکاری کردند.

examples.english: She prefers to collaborate with musicians outside her own genre.
examples.persian: او ترجیح می‌دهد با نوازندگانی خارج از سبک موسیقی خودش همکاری کند.

miniContext: During the war, scientists who had spent their careers as bitter rivals were suddenly forced to collaborate on a single, urgent project. Pride made it difficult at first, but necessity taught them to collaborate in ways neither side would have chosen freely. Decades later, several credited that uneasy collaboration with advances that might otherwise have taken another generation.

examples.english: She decided to commit to the marathon training program for a full year.
examples.persian: او تصمیم گرفت برای یک سال کامل به برنامه‌ی تمرین ماراتن متعهد شود.

examples.english: The government has committed significant funds to rebuilding the coastline.
examples.persian: دولت بودجه‌ی قابل‌توجهی برای بازسازی خط ساحلی متعهد شده است.

examples.english: He refused to commit himself to either candidate before the debate.
examples.persian: او پیش از مناظره حاضر نشد خود را به هیچ‌کدام از نامزدها متعهد کند.

miniContext: Few recruits truly understand what it means to commit to a decade of service until the first brutal winter of training. Those who commit halfheartedly tend to wash out within the first few months. The ones who remain are not necessarily the strongest, but the ones who commit fully, without a reserved exit in mind.

examples.english: Dolphins communicate with each other using a complex range of clicks and whistles.
examples.persian: دلفین‌ها با استفاده از مجموعه‌ای پیچیده از صداهای تیک‌تیک و سوت با یکدیگر ارتباط برقرار می‌کنند.

examples.english: The captain struggled to communicate with the crew during the storm.
examples.persian: کاپیتان در طول طوفان برای برقراری ارتباط با خدمه دچار مشکل شد.

examples.english: Her letters communicated a quiet desperation that her public speeches never revealed.
examples.persian: نامه‌های او نوعی ناامیدی خاموش را منتقل می‌کرد که سخنرانی‌های عمومی‌اش هرگز آشکار نمی‌کرد.

miniContext: Long before written language, early humans learned to communicate danger and opportunity through gesture and sound alone. Entire hunting strategies depended on how precisely a group could communicate across a distance without alerting prey. Even today, researchers studying isolated tribes are astonished by how much meaning a single gesture can communicate.

examples.english: The airline agreed to compensate passengers for the canceled flight.
examples.persian: شرکت هواپیمایی موافقت کرد خسارت مسافران پرواز لغوشده را جبران کند.

examples.english: Blind athletes often compensate for lost sight with heightened hearing.
examples.persian: ورزشکاران نابینا اغلب فقدان بینایی را با تقویت شنوایی جبران می‌کنند.

examples.english: No apology could fully compensate the family for what they had lost.
examples.persian: هیچ عذرخواهی نمی‌توانست آنچه آن خانواده از دست داده بود را به‌طور کامل جبران کند.

miniContext: After the factory closed, the company offered to compensate former workers with a small severance package. Union leaders argued that no amount of money could truly compensate for decades of lost pensions. The dispute over how fairly the workers had been compensated dragged through the courts for years.

examples.english: She needs complete silence to concentrate while writing.
examples.persian: او برای تمرکز کردن هنگام نوشتن به سکوت کامل نیاز دارد.

examples.english: Most of the country's wealth is concentrated in just three cities.
examples.persian: بیشتر ثروت کشور تنها در سه شهر متمرکز شده است.

examples.english: It is hard to concentrate on a lecture after a sleepless night.
examples.persian: تمرکز کردن روی یک سخنرانی پس از یک شب بی‌خوابی سخت است.

miniContext: Pilots are trained to concentrate on a handful of critical instruments during an emergency, ignoring everything that is not immediately relevant. A pilot who tries to concentrate on too many signals at once often misses the one that matters most. That narrow, disciplined ability to concentrate is, instructors say, what separates a calm landing from a disaster.

examples.english: She finally decided to confront her former business partner about the missing funds.
examples.persian: او سرانجام تصمیم گرفت شریک تجاری سابقش را درباره‌ی پول‌های گم‌شده مواجه کند.

examples.english: The small village had to confront the reality of rising sea levels.
examples.persian: روستای کوچک مجبور شد با واقعیت بالا آمدن سطح دریا روبه‌رو شود.

examples.english: Soldiers on the front line were confronted with scenes no training could prepare them for.
examples.persian: سربازان در خط مقدم با صحنه‌هایی مواجه شدند که هیچ آموزشی نمی‌توانست آن‌ها را برای آن آماده کند.

miniContext: Few leaders enjoy having to confront a popular colleague over mismanaged funds, but avoiding the issue only let the damage grow. When she finally chose to confront him directly, the conversation lasted barely ten minutes. Sometimes the hardest part of a crisis is not solving it, but working up the will to confront it at all.

examples.english: Volunteers from across the country contribute thousands of hours to the rebuilding effort every year.
examples.persian: داوطلبانی از سراسر کشور هر سال هزاران ساعت به تلاش بازسازی مشارکت می‌کنند.

examples.english: Poor diet and lack of sleep both contribute to chronic fatigue.
examples.persian: رژیم غذایی ضعیف و کمبود خواب هر دو در خستگی مزمن مشارکت و نقش دارند.

examples.english: Every household was asked to contribute a small amount toward the new well.
examples.persian: از هر خانوار خواسته شد مقدار کمی برای چاه جدید مشارکت و پرداخت کند.

miniContext: Historians now believe that a dozen minor factors, not one single cause, contributed to the empire's collapse. Drought contributed to failing harvests, which in turn contributed to unrest among soldiers who had gone unpaid for months. No one event explains the fall, but each contributing factor made the next one more likely.

examples.english: Rescue teams had to coordinate their search across three different counties.
examples.persian: تیم‌های نجات مجبور شدند جست‌وجوی خود را در سه شهرستان مختلف هماهنگ کنند.

examples.english: The conductor coordinates dozens of musicians who cannot see each other on stage.
examples.persian: رهبر ارکستر ده‌ها نوازنده‌ای که روی صحنه یکدیگر را نمی‌بینند را هماهنگ می‌کند.

examples.english: Without a radio, the two ships could not coordinate their approach to the harbor.
examples.persian: بدون بی‌سیم، دو کشتی نمی‌توانستند ورود خود به بندر را هماهنگ کنند.

miniContext: A wildfire spreading across state lines forces agencies that rarely speak to each other to coordinate within hours. In the chaos of the first night, no one was coordinating anything, and crews from neighboring counties nearly collided on the same ridge. By morning, a single command center had been set up specifically to coordinate every truck, helicopter, and volunteer.

examples.english: The experiment was designed to demonstrate how quickly ice melts in salt water.
examples.persian: این آزمایش طراحی شده بود تا نشان دهد یخ چقدر سریع در آب نمکی آب می‌شود.

examples.english: She demonstrated remarkable composure while testifying before the committee.
examples.persian: او هنگام شهادت دادن در برابر کمیته آرامش فوق‌العاده‌ای از خود نشان داد.

examples.english: Thousands gathered downtown to demonstrate against the proposed tax increase.
examples.persian: هزاران نفر در مرکز شهر گرد هم آمدند تا علیه افزایش مالیات پیشنهادی تظاهرات کنند.

miniContext: The physics teacher liked to demonstrate each law before explaining its formula, convinced that a falling ball taught more than any equation on the board. Students who could not follow the math alone often understood the concept the moment they saw it demonstrated in front of them. Decades later, several credited that single demonstration with their decision to study science at all.

examples.english: The board will discuss the merger proposal at tomorrow's meeting.
examples.persian: هیئت‌مدیره فردا در جلسه‌اش پیشنهاد ادغام را بحث خواهد کرد.

examples.english: Historians still discuss whether the treaty could have prevented the war.
examples.persian: تاریخ‌دانان هنوز بحث می‌کنند که آیا آن معاهده می‌توانست جنگ را متوقف کند یا نه.

examples.english: They discussed the novel's ending for nearly an hour after the film finished.
examples.persian: آن‌ها پس از پایان فیلم، نزدیک به یک ساعت درباره‌ی پایان رمان بحث کردند.

miniContext: Every autumn, the same four scholars gather at the conference to discuss a manuscript that still resists a final interpretation. What begins as a calm discussion often turns, by the second day, into a heated argument over a single disputed word. Colleagues joke that they attend less to hear new findings than to watch the two rivals discuss, yet again, the same unresolved question.

examples.english: Even experts struggle to distinguish the forged signature from the original.
examples.persian: حتی کارشناسان هم در تشخیص امضای تقلبی از اصلی مشکل دارند.

examples.english: A trained ear can distinguish the two violins by their tone alone.
examples.persian: یک گوش ورزیده می‌تواند آن دو ویولن را تنها از روی صدایشان تشخیص دهد و از هم متمایز کند.

examples.english: The court must distinguish between genuine error and deliberate fraud.
examples.persian: دادگاه باید میان خطای واقعی و تقلب عمدی تمایز قائل شود.

miniContext: Wine tasters train for years to distinguish subtle differences between vintages that most people would describe simply as red or white. What distinguishes a great taster is not a sharper tongue but a vocabulary precise enough to name what the tongue already senses. Without that language, even a palate able to distinguish everything has no way to describe what it has found.

examples.english: Hikers occasionally encounter bears along this stretch of the trail.
examples.persian: کوهنوردان گاهی در این بخش از مسیر با خرس‌ها مواجه می‌شوند.

examples.english: The expedition encountered unexpected resistance from local tribes along the river.
examples.persian: گروه اکسپدیشن در طول رودخانه با مقاومت غیرمنتظره‌ای از سوی قبایل محلی مواجه شد.

examples.english: She had never encountered such hostility in twenty years of diplomacy.
examples.persian: او در بیست سال دیپلماسی هرگز با چنین خصومتی مواجه نشده بود.

miniContext: Deep-sea divers occasionally encounter creatures that have never been formally described, drifting past a submersible's lights for only a few seconds. Most such encounters go undocumented, since no camera happens to be rolling at the right moment. Scientists now design expeditions specifically hoping to encounter, and this time record, exactly those fleeting creatures.

examples.english: Good teachers encourage struggling students rather than giving up on them.
examples.persian: معلمان خوب دانش‌آموزان ناموفق را تشویق می‌کنند، نه اینکه از آن‌ها ناامید شوند.

examples.english: The new tax policy is designed to encourage small businesses to hire more staff.
examples.persian: سیاست مالیاتی جدید طراحی شده است تا کسب‌وکارهای کوچک را به استخدام نیروی بیشتر تشویق کند.

examples.english: Coaches who encourage rather than criticize tend to build more resilient athletes.
examples.persian: مربیانی که به‌جای انتقاد، تشویق می‌کنند معمولاً ورزشکاران مقاوم‌تری پرورش می‌دهند.

miniContext: A single teacher who chooses to encourage a struggling student, rather than write them off, can change the direction of an entire life. Research on resilience keeps returning to the same finding: children who had at least one adult willing to encourage them fared far better than equally talented peers who did not. It costs almost nothing to encourage someone, yet the effect can last decades.

examples.english: Doctors will evaluate the patient's condition again in forty-eight hours.
examples.persian: پزشکان وضعیت بیمار را دوباره پس از چهل‌وهشت ساعت ارزیابی خواهند کرد.

examples.english: The committee was asked to evaluate each proposal strictly on its scientific merit.
examples.persian: از کمیته خواسته شد هر پیشنهاد را دقیقاً بر اساس ارزش علمی‌اش ارزیابی کند.

examples.english: Teachers evaluate essays using a rubric rather than personal impression alone.
examples.persian: معلمان مقاله‌ها را با استفاده از یک معیار مشخص، نه صرفاً برداشت شخصی، ارزیابی می‌کنند.

miniContext: Before any bridge opens to traffic, engineers evaluate every joint and cable under loads far heavier than it will ever carry. A structure that passes one test is still evaluated repeatedly under different conditions, since a single simulation rarely reveals every weakness. The public rarely sees how much is evaluated before a single car is allowed to cross.

examples.english: Holiday sales often exceed even the most optimistic forecasts a company makes.
examples.persian: فروش ایام تعطیلات اغلب از خوش‌بینانه‌ترین پیش‌بینی‌های یک شرکت هم فراتر می‌رود.

examples.english: Drivers who exceed the speed limit in the school zone face a heavy fine.
examples.persian: رانندگانی که در محدوده‌ی مدرسه از سرعت مجاز فراتر می‌روند با جریمه‌ی سنگینی مواجه می‌شوند.

examples.english: Her final score exceeded even her own coach's expectations.
examples.persian: نمره‌ی نهایی او حتی از انتظارات مربی خودش هم فراتر رفت.

miniContext: Few scientists expected the rocket's new engine to exceed its predicted thrust by nearly twenty percent during the first test. Engineers are usually wary when a result seems to exceed every projection, since an unexplained surplus often signals a measurement error rather than a triumph. In this case, however, repeated tests confirmed that the engine truly did exceed its design specifications.

examples.english: A neutral mediator was brought in to facilitate talks between the two unions.
examples.persian: یک میانجی بی‌طرف برای تسهیل گفت‌وگوها میان دو اتحادیه وارد عمل شد.

examples.english: Wider corridors were built to facilitate the movement of wounded soldiers.
examples.persian: راهروهای عریض‌تر ساخته شدند تا جابه‌جایی سربازان زخمی را تسهیل کنند.

examples.english: The new bridge facilitates trade between villages that were once cut off by the river.
examples.persian: پل جدید تجارت میان روستاهایی را که زمانی توسط رودخانه از هم جدا شده بودند، تسهیل می‌کند.

miniContext: Diplomats rarely solve a conflict themselves; their role is usually to facilitate a conversation that the two sides are too proud to start on their own. A skilled mediator does not take sides but simply works to facilitate trust long enough for a real negotiation to happen. Historians often credit such quiet facilitation, rather than any treaty's wording, with preventing wars that never made the news.

examples.english: The contractor failed to fulfill the terms of the original agreement.
examples.persian: پیمانکار در برآورده کردن شرایط توافق اصلی ناکام ماند.

examples.english: She finally fulfilled her childhood dream of climbing the mountain.
examples.persian: او سرانجام رویای کودکی‌اش برای فتح آن کوه را برآورده کرد.

examples.english: The charity's mission is to fulfill basic needs in areas devastated by war.
examples.persian: مأموریت این خیریه برآورده کردن نیازهای اولیه در مناطق ویران‌شده از جنگ است.

miniContext: He had spent thirty years training for a single Olympic race, and when he finally crossed the line first, he said simply that he had fulfilled the only promise he had ever made to his father. Most athletes never get the chance to fulfill a dream that specific. For him, fulfilling it meant that everything after that moment, win or lose, no longer mattered.

examples.english: Only trained technicians are allowed to handle the radioactive samples.
examples.persian: فقط تکنسین‌های آموزش‌دیده اجازه دارند نمونه‌های رادیواکتیو را دست‌بگیرند و مدیریت کنند.

examples.english: She handled the crisis with a calm that surprised even her colleagues.
examples.persian: او بحران را با آرامشی مدیریت کرد که حتی همکارانش را هم شگفت‌زده کرد.

examples.english: The old elevator can no longer handle more than four passengers at once.
examples.persian: آسانسور قدیمی دیگر نمی‌تواند بیش از چهار مسافر را هم‌زمان حمل و مدیریت کند.

miniContext: Museum conservators wear cotton gloves to handle fragile manuscripts that even a trace of skin oil could damage within years. New staff are trained for months before they are trusted to handle anything older than a century. It is slow, careful work, but a single careless way to handle a priceless document can erase centuries of history in seconds.

examples.english: Investigators were able to identify the suspect from a partial fingerprint.
examples.persian: بازرسان توانستند مظنون را از روی اثر انگشت ناقصی شناسایی کنند.

examples.english: Botanists identified a previously unknown species of orchid in the reserve.
examples.persian: گیاه‌شناسان گونه‌ای ناشناخته از ارکیده را در آن منطقه‌ی حفاظت‌شده شناسایی کردند.

examples.english: She could identify every bird by its call alone, without ever seeing it.
examples.persian: او می‌توانست هر پرنده را تنها از روی صدایش شناسایی کند، بدون آنکه آن را ببیند.

miniContext: Forensic teams sometimes need weeks to identify a body using nothing but dental records and a fragment of clothing. Families waiting for word often describe the uncertainty as worse than grief itself; until a victim is formally identified, there is no funeral, no closure, nothing to mark as final. The work of identifying the dead, however slow, is what eventually lets the living move forward.

examples.english: The city plans to implement a new recycling program next spring.
examples.persian: شهرداری قصد دارد بهار آینده یک برنامه‌ی بازیافت جدید را اجرا کند.

examples.english: The reforms were difficult to implement in rural areas with no internet access.
examples.persian: اجرای این اصلاحات در مناطق روستایی بدون دسترسی به اینترنت دشوار بود.

examples.english: Once approved, the new safety regulations will be implemented within six months.
examples.persian: پس از تصویب، مقررات ایمنی جدید ظرف شش ماه اجرا خواهند شد.

miniContext: Passing a law and making it work are two very different problems; a reform that looks elegant on paper can be nearly impossible to implement in a country with few trained inspectors. The ministry spent two years trying to implement a tax code that had taken only a single afternoon to draft. In the end, officials admitted that how carefully a policy is implemented matters as much as how wisely it was written.

examples.english: The union agreed to negotiate a new contract before the strike deadline.
examples.persian: اتحادیه موافقت کرد پیش از موعد نهایی اعتصاب، قرارداد جدیدی مذاکره کند.

examples.english: She managed to negotiate a lower price for the entire shipment.
examples.persian: او موفق شد برای کل محموله قیمتی پایین‌تر مذاکره و توافق کند.

examples.english: The two generals negotiated a brief ceasefire to recover the wounded.
examples.persian: دو ژنرال برای بازگرداندن مجروحان، آتش‌بسی موقت مذاکره کردند.

miniContext: Hostage negotiators are trained never to negotiate against a deadline they did not set themselves, since urgency favors the person holding the gun. A good negotiator instead works to slow the conversation down, trading small concessions for time. It is often the side willing to negotiate patiently, rather than the side with more leverage, that walks away with the better outcome.

examples.english: It took her nearly an hour to persuade the landlord to lower the rent.
examples.persian: او تقریباً یک ساعت وقت صرف کرد تا صاحبخانه را به کاهش اجاره‌بها متقاعد کند.

examples.english: No amount of evidence could persuade him to change his mind.
examples.persian: هیچ مقدار از شواهد نتوانست او را متقاعد کند نظرش را تغییر دهد.

examples.english: The lawyer's closing statement persuaded even the most doubtful jurors.
examples.persian: اظهارات پایانی وکیل حتی شاکی‌ترین هیئت‌منصفه را هم متقاعد کرد.

miniContext: Advertisers spend fortunes trying to persuade an audience in thirty seconds what a friend might fail to persuade them of in an hour. The most effective pitches rarely rely on facts alone to persuade; they borrow trust, humor, or fear instead. Studying what actually works to persuade people, rather than what seems logical, has become a science of its own.

examples.english: Emergency room doctors must prioritize patients by the severity of their injuries.
examples.persian: پزشکان اورژانس باید بیماران را بر اساس شدت آسیب‌هایشان در اولویت قرار دهند.

examples.english: The new mayor promised to prioritize affordable housing over new office towers.
examples.persian: شهردار جدید قول داد مسکن ارزان‌قیمت را بر برج‌های اداری جدید در اولویت قرار دهد.

examples.english: She learned to prioritize her own health after years of overworking.
examples.persian: او پس از سال‌ها کار بیش از حد، یاد گرفت سلامتی خودش را در اولویت قرار دهد.

miniContext: During a mass casualty event, nurses are trained to prioritize ruthlessly, treating the patients most likely to survive before those whose injuries, however severe, leave little hope. Learning to prioritize under that kind of pressure, instructors admit, is one of the hardest and most psychologically brutal parts of the job. Those who refuse to prioritize, treating every case as equally urgent, often end up saving fewer lives overall.

examples.english: The two neighbors agreed to resolve their decade-long dispute over the fence.
examples.persian: دو همسایه موافقت کردند اختلاف چندین‌ساله‌ی خود بر سر دیوار حیاط را حل کنند.

examples.english: She resolved to finish the manuscript before the end of the year.
examples.persian: او تصمیم قاطع گرفت پیش از پایان سال دست‌نوشته را تمام کند.

examples.english: The committee could not resolve the disagreement without outside arbitration.
examples.persian: کمیته بدون داوری خارجی نتوانست آن اختلاف را حل کند.

miniContext: Family courts are built around the hope that a dispute can be resolved without putting a child through a public trial. Mediators try to resolve what they can quietly, reserving the courtroom for cases where no agreement seems possible. Even then, a judge's ruling does not always resolve the underlying hurt, only the legal question in front of them.
